meaning.zh:
“发财” 或 “获得重大收益”。

这个成语源自采矿业中的一个术语，指的是当矿工挖到了富含矿物的土质层或金矿时，他们找到了有价值的矿藏。因此，这个短语被引申用来表示在某项活动中取得了重大成功或发现了非常有价值的东西。
meaning.en: This idiom originates from a mining term indicating when miners would strike a layer of earth rich in minerals or gold, thus finding something valuable. Over time, it has been extended to mean achieving significant success or discovering something greatly valuable in any activity.

lines.en: After years of research, the scientists finally *hit pay dirt* with their groundbreaking discovery.
lines.zh: 经过多年的研究，科学家们终于通过他们的突破性发现发了财。

lines.en: The startup *hit pay dirt* when they launched their innovative app.
lines.zh: 那家初创公司在推出他们的创新应用时发了财。

lines.en: They didn't expect much from the new investment, but they actually *hit pay dirt*.
lines.zh: 他们对新的投资并没有抱太大期望，但实际上他们却发财了。
